name: Red-bellied Woodpecker
desc: Red-bellied Woodpecker (Melanerpes carolinus): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 60 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The red-bellied woodpecker is a medium-sized woodpecker of the family Picidae. It breeds mainly in the eastern United States, ranging as far south as Florida and as far north as Canada.
